page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries, Hebrew and Latin. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: צַחְיָה m. Nitor, Nitidum: Arduus, Eminens locus, qui suâ naturâ aridus & glaber, nitorem refert: plur. צְחִיחִים Ardua vel arida loca.
צָחַק Rifit, Arrifit. Pihel צִחֵק Irrifit, Illufit, Lufit, Jocatus est.
צִיָּה f. Siccitas, Siticulosus locus: plur. צִיּוֹת.
צִי m. Navis: plural. צִים & צִיִּים Naves: item Arida, Deserta loca: metonymicè Feri, Barbari, desertorum locorum incolæ: Fera animalia.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some forms in the entries are hard to read at this scan resolution; doubtful forms are marked [?]. The catchword at the foot is read as צִיץ.
